persona: Ken, 26, remote (Singapore). Spot crypto trader on Binance, trades at any hour, pays fees in USDT, BNB or the bought coin. Wants honest P&L in USDT and to stop reconciling exchange exports by hand.
accounting_choice: A fee paid in the bought coin (0.00003 BTC) reduces the quantity received: 0.03 BTC bought -> 0.02997 BTC held. Average cost = 7861 USDT / 0.07997 BTC. Net P&L is not asserted because one fee is in BNB.
traps: Pair instead of ticker + currency: BTCUSDT means BTC priced in USDT (quote currency is not USD)
Fee in three different assets: quote (USDT), base (BTC) and BNB
No trade id: two fills of 0.01 BTC at the same second and price look identical and must not be de-duplicated
Times are UTC ('Date(UTC)'), trading 24/7 incl. 23:41 and 03:05
